comment:
* Class representing a configured provider. Encapsulates configuration
 * (className plus optional argument), the provider loading logic, and
 * the loaded Provider object itself.
 *
 * @author  Andreas Sterbenz
 * @since   1.5

variables.name: P11_SOL_ARG
variables.comment: config file argument of the SunPKCS11-Solaris provider

variables.name: MAX_LOAD_TRIES
variables.comment: maximum number of times to try loading a provider before giving up

variables.name: tries
variables.comment: number of times we have already tried to load this provider

methods.name: private void checkSunPKCS11Solaris()
methods.comment: or if disabled via system property

methods.name: private boolean shouldLoad()
methods.comment: should we try to load this provider?

methods.name: private void disableLoad()
methods.comment: do not try to load this provider again

methods.name: synchronized Provider getProvider()
methods.comment: * Get the provider object. Loads the provider if it is not already loaded.

methods.name: private Provider doLoadProvider()
methods.comment:
* Load and instantiate the Provider described by this class.
     *
     * NOTE use of doPrivileged().
     *
     * @return null if the Provider could not be loaded
     *
     * @throws ProviderException if executing the Provider's constructor
     * throws a ProviderException. All other Exceptions are ignored.

methods.name: private Provider initProvider(String className, ClassLoader cl) throws Exception
private static String expand(final String value)
methods.comment:
* Perform property expansion of the provider value.
     *
     * NOTE use of doPrivileged().
